name: learning
description: Socratic teach-and-quiz skills that verify you deeply understand a session or a topic.

interface.longDescription: Two Socratic tutoring skills: quiz yourself on the current session's work, or on any topic you name. The assistant builds a must-understand checklist, teaches the gaps, and quizzes you item by item until you demonstrate mastery.
